ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 65:35 ratio of low-intensity (dark grey/black) to high-intensity (white) pixels across the visible ventral area.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Central peduncle transition area is a solid low-intensity block. The left lobe contains a peripheral high-intensity band with internal low-intensity stippling. The right lobe contains a large, contiguous high-intensity field in the outer two-thirds, featuring dense low-intensity mottling and focal spots.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped notch with an internal vertex angle of approximately 48 degrees; depth is roughly 12% of the fluke vertical height from base to trailing edge.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: The boundary is highly irregular; the left lobe trailing edge displays 5 distinct low-amplitude serrations; the right lobe trailing edge displays 8 distinct medium-amplitude peaks and valleys.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curve extending from the median notch, transitioning to a slight concavity toward the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Discrete high-contrast circular white pixel clusters (3-7 pixels diameter) are distributed across the central dark region. Textured, high-contrast protrusions are localized at the terminal tips of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Two distinct, low-intensity linear tracks (~20 pixels in length) are visible on the high-intensity field of the right lobe, oriented diagonally to the trailing edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Textured protrusions at both distal tips; irregular jagged indentation on the trailing edge of the right lobe.
